subject: *: support tidb_opt_use_invisible_indexes (#50654)
summary: Adds session sysvar `tidb_opt_use_invisible_indexes` (default OFF) wiring to `SessionVars.OptimizerUseInvisibleIndexes`; planner point-get/batch-point-get now allows invisible unique indexes when enabled; internal restricted sessions propagate the flag; adds a planner test covering EXPLAIN behavior with an invisible index.
